Rights & attribution

Materials with confirmed terms of use; text and recording rights are separate.

This page lists materials with confirmed terms of use. It is not a complete catalog of materials used in the apps. Rights to a Bible text and to a recording of that text are separate. Software licenses do not grant rights to third-party texts or recordings.

Text based on World English Bible (British edition)

Credit: World English Bible contributors; British edition published by eBible.org.

Public domain. The publisher declares the translation public domain and permits copying, publication, transmission and redistribution.

Attribution:
The World English Bible British edition source text is in the public domain. Prepared for Bible Garden from the stored edition.

Changes: Converted to application data and HTML formats; red-letter markup was transferred onto the stored wording. Differences between the stored wording and later source editions are documented; a complete word-level comparison has not been performed.

Trademark terms: World English Bible is a trademark identifying faithful copies. If the words are changed, the resulting text must not be called World English Bible. The name here identifies the source translation; it is not a certification that every stored word matches the current publisher edition.
